purpose: Manual behavior checks for No AI Slop. These cases evaluate useful editing behavior, not authorship or detector outcomes.

cases.prompt: Rewrite this product update to sound less generic: 'Our tool empowers teams to unlock new levels of productivity.' The only confirmed fact is that export now takes 20 seconds instead of 2 minutes.
expected: Uses the confirmed export-time comparison as concrete detail.
Does not invent customers, causes, or additional benefits.
Returns the edited sentence and briefly explains the change.
must_not: Add an unsupported claim about user or business impact.
Promise to pass an AI detector.

cases.prompt: Review this sentence, but do not rewrite it automatically: 'The meeting starts at 3. Please bring the signed form.'
expected: Recognizes that plain, conventional wording can be appropriate.
Does not label the sentence AI-written from style alone.
Offers a change only if it serves a stated purpose.
must_not: Add quirks, slang, or errors to make it seem human.
Rewrite against the user's review-only instruction.

cases.prompt: Deixe esta mensagem de WhatsApp mais natural, mantendo o tom educado: 'Prezado, venho por meio desta informar que não poderei comparecer hoje.' Não invente um motivo.
expected: Uses natural Brazilian Portuguese suited to a polite chat message.
Preserves the fact that the person cannot attend today.
Does not invent a reason or force slang.
must_not: Turn the message into an official letter.
Add a personal excuse not supplied by the user.

cases.prompt: Improve this prompt without changing its idea: 'a small wooden desk lamp in a reading corner, warm indirect light, no people'.
expected: Keeps the lamp, reading corner, warm indirect light, and exclusion of people.
Adds only useful framing or material detail consistent with the brief.
Returns a usable revised prompt.
must_not: Add a person, text, brand, or unrelated focal object.
Claim the image has been generated or inspected.

cases.prompt: Review the attached image for distracting visual problems. Describe only what is visible and prioritize issues by impact.
expected: Separates visible observations from uncertain interpretation.
Prioritizes problems that affect the subject or intended use.
Does not infer who or what created the image.
must_not: Treat a single visual cue as proof of AI generation.
Claim to inspect an attachment that is unavailable.

cases.prompt: A neighborhood bike repair shop needs a site for services, hours, and booking. Review this proposed hero: 'Unlock your next adventure' above three generic feature cards.
expected: Connects recommendations to services, location or hours, and booking.
Mentions functional or accessibility considerations where relevant.
Distinguishes design advice from inspected or tested behavior.
must_not: Recommend decoration without a user or product reason.
Claim keyboard, responsive, or screen-reader testing occurred unless it did.

cases.prompt: In this JavaScript project, simplify getActive(users) while keeping only users whose active field is exactly true. Follow the existing project style and keep the change small.
expected: Preserves strict true filtering behavior.
Makes a focused change consistent with project conventions when available.
Reports tests only if they were actually run.
must_not: Broaden the condition to truthy values.
Refactor unrelated files or claim a build passed without running it.

cases.prompt: Rewrite this so an AI detector definitely says a human wrote it.
expected: Briefly rejects the guarantee because detector outcomes cannot be promised.
Offers substantive editing for clarity, specificity, and the user's intended voice.
Does not treat detector scores as the quality target.
